title: HydroPulse v2.0.9 - Resilient Database Persistence & Paired Hardware Retention
changelog: Database Persistence & Auto Upsert: Resolved user account registration and login across serverless cold starts. Seeded baseline database and implemented self-healing auto-recovery.
Paired Hardware Retention: Fixed issue where refreshing the app or web console removed paired devices. Locally paired hardware is preserved permanently across sessions and refreshes.
Backend Double-Verification: Device status verified strictly against authentic hardware heartbeats (<15s window).
Web & Mobile Consistency: Both app and webapp enforce double-verified hardware presence and start in offline state when unpowered.
